items.markdown:
If you’re looking around Nottingham, I’d start with **The Kennel Club’s Find a Puppy** rather than buying from a generic classified advert. You can filter for Staffordshire Bull Terriers, location, and puppies whose parents have been health tested. [thekennelclub.org.uk](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/find-an-assured-breeder/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/find-an-assured-breeder/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) 

A couple of nearby leads came up in the local search, but I **wouldn’t treat a listing or review rating as proof that a breeder is reputable**:

- [Earlsgrave Bull Terriers](https://www.earlsgravebullterriers.com/) — Kidderminster, roughly within reach of Nottingham.
- The Staffordshire Bull Terrier Club — Cannock; a breed club can be useful for finding established breeders and getting breed-specific advice.
- [RSPCA Radcliffe Animal Centre](http://www.rspca-radcliffe.org.uk/) — near Nottingham, worth considering if you're open to a Staffy needing a home rather than specifically a puppy.

### What I'd ask a breeder

For a **blue Staffy**, don't let colour be the main thing you evaluate. Ask:

1. **“Can I see the mum with the puppies?”**
 You should see the puppy interacting with its mother and view where the litter has been raised. The Kennel Club specifically advises meeting the breeder, seeing the dam and seeing the puppy before committing. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/find-an-assured-breeder/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
2. **“Can I see the health-test certificates for both parents?”**
 For Staffordshire Bull Terriers, The Kennel Club recommends testing including **HC-HSF4 hereditary cataracts, L-2-HGA, elbow dysplasia and eye screening**. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/breeds-a-to-z/breeds/terrier/staffordshire-bull-terrier/?gad=1&utm_source=chatgpt.com) [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/media/cvef530x/kc_health_standard_07-25-web.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
3. **“What are the parents' registered names and Kennel Club registration numbers?”**
 You can then independently check recorded health-test results rather than relying on a screenshot or the breeder's word. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/dog-breeding/first-time-breeders/health-screening-a-step-by-step-guide/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
4. **“What are the parents' L-2-HGA and HC results?”**
 Ask specifically whether each parent is **clear, carrier or affected**, and ask to see the actual results. Both parents contribute genetic material to the puppies, so testing both matters. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/dog-breeding/first-time-breeders/health-screening-a-step-by-step-guide/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
5. **“Have there been skin problems, allergies, breathing problems, joint problems or other significant illnesses in the parents or close relatives?”**
 Skin conditions are one of the breed's current health priorities identified by The Kennel Club. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/breeds-a-to-z/breeds/terrier/staffordshire-bull-terrier/?gad=1&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
6. **“What is the parents' coefficient of inbreeding (COI)?”**
 Ask them to explain how they considered genetic diversity when choosing the mating.
7. **“What socialisation have the puppies had?”**
 Ask about household noises, visitors, handling, children, other dogs, car journeys, grooming and being left briefly alone.
8. **“What will the puppy leave with?”**
 Ask about microchipping, vaccinations, worming, vet examination, registration/pedigree paperwork, food, insurance and the contract/health guarantee.
9. **“What happens if I can't keep the dog later?”**
 A conscientious breeder should care about the dog's lifetime welfare and have a clear return/rehome policy.

### One important point about “blue”

I'd be particularly cautious of a breeder charging a **large premium because the puppy is blue** or marketing blue Staffies primarily as a rare/designer colour. Ask about the breeder's health and breeding programme first, not just colour.

If you give me your **maximum driving distance from Nottingham (e.g. 30, 50 or 100 miles)** and whether you want **KC-registered only**, I can search for current Staffordshire Bull Terrier litters and narrow it down to breeders you can investigate.
